scope: Nepal medical discovery — B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: BPKIHS maintains a current official institutional notice/download site, with 2026 entrance and admission materials for postgraduate and fellowship routes.
Nepal's Medical Education Commission lists BPKIHS in undergraduate matching material as the relevant university/academy for allocated health-professions seats.
The Nepal Medical Council's MBBS accreditation standards refer to BPKIHS as an institution whose faculty appointments are governed under national standards.

holdReasons: No current official BPKIHS MBBS programme, duration, fee, admission, language or foreign-student source was established.
The national standards document is not evidence of a current programme-specific accreditation decision or recognition badge.
A complete clinical-placement, accommodation and international-support packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain BPKIHS's current undergraduate MBBS prospectus and authoritative fee/admission evidence, then independently verify programme recognition and clinical/student-support details before packaging.
